verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an MCP directory, hosting and gateway platform with a REST API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents acting on many items at once, such as batch endpoints, multi-select actions or bulk tool or server management. Per-tool access control, directory sync and schedules/webhooks are adjacent features, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
